findings.text: The company was incorporated on 27 November 1947 and has been active for 78.9 years.
There is no insolvency record held for the company at Companies House.
Accounts are not overdue, with the next due date being 26 August 2027, and the confirmation statement is not overdue, with the next due date being 2 July 2027.
There are 2 outstanding charges registered against the company, alongside 7 satisfied charges.
No current person with significant control is on record, which does not prove the company has no owner.
The company has 11 current officers, including 10 directors and 1 other officer.
Across 5 current directors checked, links were found to 83 other companies, including one in liquidation.
Since 24 October 2025, there have been no registered office address changes and one director resignation.

headline.text: TESCO PLC is an active company with no insolvency records, up-to-date filings, and outstanding secured charges.
